oraclePolicy.independent: Write literal expected semantic roles/IDs/unknowns/labels from hash-bound adopted contract and article. Never import production frame/fixture or turn observed DOM values into expected values. Additional scoped collector hooks and precise wording are reviewed during implementation, not silently treated as existing adopted IDs.
oraclePolicy.visible: Match exact adopted labels where fixed and reviewed bounded visible-text alternatives for explanatory meaning, per local role/row/caveat. Do not accept data-ID/boolean alone, hidden title/desc, a different panel's matching phrase, or whole-page substring searches. Negation/reversal must fail.
oraclePolicy.geometry: Record visible node rectangles, path endpoints/arrow markers and scoped row/boundary boxes in one coordinate system. Check branch separation and causal direction against real SVG edges. Horizontal/vertical painted strokes with one zero bbox dimension are visible; length/stroke and endpoints matter. Image review decides suspected glyph collision; no automatic bounding-box-only acceptance.
oraclePolicy.numeric: This is conceptual, not a performed probe/intervention/SAE experiment. Unknown measurements stay null/unmeasured. Literal zero and nonnegative sign belong to the existing SAE formula; drawn slot counts/positions are illustration structure, not empirical dimensions/features/coefficients. Do not invent named discovered features or numeric quality.
oraclePolicy.model: Shared finite phase clamp/rounding, deterministic plain data, no DOM/network/randomness/timer, fresh nested output and stable identities. Invalid phase/options fail closed; allowed intervention values only. Any exception subtype not fixed by adopted contract must be resolved consistently in implementation rather than invented by this plan.

visibleByStage: S0: input/output behavioral observation and internal mechanism view simultaneously; complementary methods and no single decisive method. Internal view does not replace external evaluation.

S1: representation-h branches to separately trained probe-independent while original model-output-y route stays separate. Explain accessible information versus actual causal use; probe output never drives model output. Successful decoding/accuracy is not asserted from an unperformed experiment.

S2: distinct attention and attribution panels, with both dispute positions visible concurrently: attention alone is not sufficient explanation; explanation definition and model-wide tests matter. Symbolic highlights only, no scored colorbar/normalized attention array. Shared schematic input/output is not a measured equal-prediction experiment.

S3: exactly two comparable normal/intervened lanes with the same input-x and only component-target changed. Each lane has its own scoped visible input, target state and output status; comparison remains pending/unmeasured under either intervention. Already show A B … A and induction-head candidate label at this READ, not only S4.

S4: retain conceptual A B … A → candidate B and residual-stream context. Timing association is not causal proof; candidate mechanism is not a whole-model/all-ICL explanation. Visible boundary blocks that extrapolation without making a new model result.
geometryChecks: S1 branch originates at representation-h and reaches independent probe; no probe-output→model-output arrow or visual merge suggesting causal use.

S3 both lane input labels equal input-x; normal state and intervention targets stay inside their own lanes and only selected target treatment changes. Collect each lane separately, not aggregate counts.

S3/S4 repeated A/B glyphs remain distinguishable occurrences in the pattern; continuation B connects from the candidate pattern. Do not use a glyph label alone as an occurrence identifier or invent a fixed E2-hook contract not adopted here.
S4 candidate scope and limitation text are visible near the mechanism; no arrow from candidate boundary to a whole-model proven/safe conclusion.
figures.selectorPlan: Ten-cell stored choice×stage grid; two activeS3 states in panel and modal. Inactive0/1/2/4 effective null and no visual/semantic change. Retain chosen value when returning toS3. Alternate replace also traverses both activation boundaries forward/reverse. Other figure's phase is unaffected.

visibleByStage: S0: one neuron/dimension can be associated with multiple symbolic features; neither universal one-to-one concept correspondence nor named empirically discovered concepts.

S1: more candidate features than dimensions is marked as a toy-model hypothesis, with d_i/d_j/ellipsis and many zero coefficient slots. SAE decomposition research path is already visible at READ1. Illustrated slot count is not actual dimension/learned-feature count.

S2: map x, f_i(x), d_i and the sparse sum to approximate xhat. Nonnegative coefficients, mostly zero; only symbolically nonzero terms contribute. Always show approximate relation and unresolved residual-r. No assigned numeric coefficients/directions/magnitudes/error, unconditional x=xhat, perfect inverse or zero-error claim.

S3: keep reconstruction objects and approximate/residual meaning while displaying three distinct unresolved issues: coverage, evaluation, scale. Lab self-report and unestablished safety guarantee remain READ-visible without a control.
geometryChecks: Different feature directions retain distinct visible identities and converge into reconstruction only via active symbolic terms; zero slots have no active contribution edge.

Each explicitly shown coefficient slot is locally classified zero or symbolic-active. Verify majority zero among explicit finite slots, excluding ellipsis; do not convert slot counts to empirical sparsity rates or dimension counts. Exact number of illustrative slots is a layout choice to freeze with authored scene and independent oracle before tests.
Approximate sign connects original/reconstruction scope and residual is visible nearby, not hidden behind another panel. Residual remains unresolved, not a measured positive magnitude or known zero.
S3 exactly three unresolved issue labels and the self-report/no-safety caveat lie in their intended scope; no connector bypasses boundary to imply full mechanism or safety proof.
figures.textNormalization: Math symbol typography may use Unicode subscripts, tspans or accessible visible equivalents, but semantic variables/indexes/operators must agree with the original formula. Do not require a duplicated KaTeX formula inside the scene.
